name: lastid-agent
description: LastID Agent — cryptographic identity for AI agents. Provisions a verifiable credential issued by your LastID so any agent runtime can prove it's acting on your behalf.

plugins.name: lastid-agent
plugins.description: Provisions a LastID-issued agent credential the first time a Claude Code session starts on a host. Surfaces a one-time approval flow to the operator's LastID wallet; persists the issued SD-JWT VC to the host keychain. Future sessions skip provisioning and run authenticated.
